children: Treasury yields are climbing after a hotter-than-expected jobs report that analysts said increases the chances the Federal Reserve will lift short-term rates at its next meeting.

The 2-year yield, which often rises and falls with traders' expectations for short-term rates set by the central bank, was recently trading around 4.4%, up from around 4.34% before the data, according to Tradeweb.
The yield on the 10-year note was recently up at around 4.792%, from around 4.75% before the report.
